overview:
Manali, Sissu and Kasol in one weekend: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** group trip leaves Delhi in the evening. The group assembles at the pickup point, gets a short briefing from the trip leaders and travels overnight in an AC vehicle to reach Manali the next morning.

Day 1 is Manali local sightseeing: Hadimba Temple, Old Manali and Mall Road, then dinner with a bonfire and light music at the hotel. Day 2 goes to Solang Valley, where ATV rides, paragliding and zipline are available at your own expense, and on through the Atal Tunnel to Sissu. Day 3 covers Manikaran and the Kasol market before a late evening departure. Prices start at ₹7,199 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

itinerary.content:
After breakfast, leave for Solang Valley, Sissu and Atal Tunnel sightseeing.
Stop at Solang Valley on the way, where you can try activities like ATV rides, paragliding and zipline (at personal expense).
Later, proceed to Sissu through the Atal Tunnel.
Spend some time at Sissu and enjoy the scenery and valley views.
Return to the hotel in the evening.
Dinner and overnight stay at the hotel.

itinerary.content:
Wake up early, have breakfast and check out.
Leave for Kasol and Manikaran sightseeing.
Reach Manikaran, known for Manikaran Sahib Gurudwara and its hot sulphur springs.
After this, explore the Kasol market.
Depart late in the evening.

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: Departure is in the evening from Delhi. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed. You travel overnight and reach the hills the next morning.

faqs.q: How much does the Manali, Sissu & Kasol trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹7,199 per person on quad sharing, ₹7,699 on triple sharing and ₹8,199 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
